correctness.rationale: For every n>=1 and S subset [n], the row-word action fixes i exactly when i is absent from the tableau, forcing bottom row S. If a second-row entry has predecessor in S, an upper generator occurrence followed by the bottom predecessor occurrence forces a two-step drop; conversely if all upper entries start support runs, each moved point drops exactly once. The normal-form row minima then encode restricted-growth strings, in bijection with set partitions; maximum height equals block count. This proves the Stirling/Bell profile including empty S, and the run and idempotent formulas follow by gap selection. Exhaustive independent generator-action checks of every tableau through n=8 succeeded, but are corroboration rather than infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact fiber size and row-length profile are intrinsic invariants of the recent stylic-to-Catalan quotient and were not addressed numerically in the motivating full-core description. The theorem completely classifies all 2^n natural one-step transformations, compressing dependence to consecutive support runs; it yields Stirling stratification, Bell fiber counts, exact binomial multiplicities, and an idempotent family with arbitrarily large fibers. This is a systematic natural enumerative classification, not an arbitrary small computational slice. Its scope and absence of broader global claims are stated.
